description: This file defines the 'Source' class in the Twig templating engine, which encapsulates information about a non-compiled template, including its code, name, and path.

classes.name: Twig\Source
classes.description: Represents a non-compiled Twig template, holding its source code, name, and optional filesystem path.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the source code of the template.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the logical name of the template.

methods.name: getPath
methods.description: Returns the filesystem path of the template if set.
